title: Verify: highlightObject focuses scene objects and unsubscribes on shutdown
summary: Unit tests for BootScene highlightObject handling
description: Fake scene objects with focus/blur spies and mocked Phaser.

steps.action: Reuse mocks from bootSceneSync.test.ts; buildScene returns two fakes with spec ids 'bookshelf' and 'door', each with focus, blur, sync, destroy, onInteract, onHover spies. After boot.create(), emit reactToPhaser highlightObject {id:'door'} and assert door.focus and bookshelf.blur called; emit {id:null} and assert both blur called; run the SHUTDOWN callback from boot.events.once mock, clear spies, emit again and assert no focus/blur calls.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneHighlight.test.ts
